summary: fix(settings): use Figma artwork for pair menu graphics
description:
Because:

* The pair menu SVGs were hand-drawn placeholders, not the Figma designs.

This commit:

* Replaces them with svgo-minified exports of the FXA-14844 Figma frames.
* Prefixes SVG ids per file so the two graphics never collide.
* Sizes the graphic to the card width.
